name: Ghost Rider (Robbie Reyes)
signatureAbility:
Speed Demon
Robbie starts each fight by granting [1 - 5] personal Ignition Buffs, rounded down. In a Battleground fight against #Villains, double the Ignitions granted. These remain paused until Robbie finishes a Special Attack.
Robbie's Hell Charger unlocks a new gear! Robbie can now Shift Gears when reaching 200 Speed.

abilitySections.title: The Demon Inside Me - Always Active
content: Robbie's connection with his possessive demonic spirit grants him Immunity to all Bleed and Incinerate effects.

Robbie does not benefit from the Mystic Dispersion Mastery, but his Hell Charger does! Each rank increases the minimum Speed of the Hell Charger by +5, and increases the base potency of the Shifting Gears Power Gain by +2% flat.

abilitySections.title: The Vengeance Engine - Max Speed: 225 (mph)
content: The Hell Charger lives for the thrill, feeding off speed and recklessness to alter the performance of Robbie's abilities. Basic Attacks grant Robbie +5 Speed per hit.
If Robbie hasn't struck the Opponent for 2.5 seconds, doubled against #Villains, Speed is lost over time. Speed loss pauses during personal Strikers and the Opponent's Special Attacks.

abilitySections.title: Shifting Gears
content: Upon hitting Speed thresholds of 50, 100, and 150, Robbie needs to Shift Gears, starting an 8 second timer that's paused during the Opponent's Special Attacks. Performing a Seeking Vengeance action in this time Shifts Gears.
Shifting Gears grants a Power Gain Passive, granting 22% of a Bar of Power over 2 seconds.
Dropping below these Speed thresholds places this Power Gain on a 5 second cooldown.

abilitySections.title: Seeking Vengeance
content: 4th hit in a combo: Gain a Grit Passive for 15 seconds and Nullify an Energize Buff on the Opponent.
Charge a Heavy Attack: Gain a non-stacking 25% Amplify Buff for 20 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Ignition
content: Robbie can grant the Opponent Ignition Buffs while the Opponent has less than 16 total Buffs. Each lasts 24 seconds, and expires 0.66% faster per Speed. Max: 50% faster.
Activating a personal Grit or Amplify grants 1 Ignition Buff.
Nullifying a Buff with Seeking Vengeance grants 2 Ignition Buffs. Staggering a Buff with a personal Stagger grants 1 Ignition per Buff removed this way, after the Special has finished.

abilitySections.title: Opponent's Special Attacks
content: When the Opponent activates a Special Attack, inflict 2 Stagger Debuffs for 1 second. One can remove any True Buff, and the other can remove any non-Ignition, non-True Buff.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1 - Anger Unchained
content: The first hit inflicts a non-stacking [1,480.77] Energy Vulnerability Debuff for 30 seconds.
Each hit grants +10 Speed and can Shift Gears if active during this attack.
The final hit inflicts a [313.86] Soul Barb Debuff for 25 seconds. Max stacks: 2.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2 - Chop Shop
content: The first hit inflicts a non-stacking [680.03] Soul Barb Passive for 15 seconds. If this attack is activated while Robbie's Energy Vulnerability is active, this Soul Barb is paused during this attack.
Each hit consumes 40 Speed to grant 2 Ignition Buffs.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3 - Meet My Ride
content: Inflict Robbie's Energy Vulnerability Debuff.
The Opponent is inflicted with a non-stacking [4,184.8] Seared Debuff for 0.1 seconds per Speed, paused during Special Attacks.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Speed Demon
content: Robbie starts each fight by granting [1 - 5] personal Ignition Buffs, rounded down. In a Battleground fight against #Villains, double the Ignitions granted. These remain paused until Robbie finishes a Special Attack.
Robbie's Hell Charger unlocks a new gear! Robbie can now Shift Gears when reaching 200 Speed.
